newsitem.title: USA: 1MAGE Software Inc ad costs hurt Q2 net.
newsitem.headline: 1MAGE Software Inc ad costs hurt Q2 net.

text.p: Increased advertising costs and a new marketing campaign pulled second quarter net income lower at 1MAGE Software Inc, the company told Reuters.

The document imaging company reported net income of $43,690 in the second quarter compared to $106,837 during the same time last year. Earnings per share were $0.02 compared to $0.05 last year, however an increase in shares outstanding to 2,147,563 from 1,969,986 was partly responsible for the decline in earnings per share.
Despite a 51 percent increase in system sales during the first half of this year, the company said in its earnings statement that it suffered a loss for the last six months of operations.
In the six months ending June 30, 1997, 1MAGE lost $0.03 a share or $64,826, compared to the same period last year.
